context.synopsis: On August 3, 2018, Trump attacked CNN anchor Don Lemon on Twitter, calling him 'the dumbest man on television' in a tweet that also targeted LeBron James after Lemon aired an interview with the athlete. Trump had previously called Lemon 'a real dummy,' 'not very bright,' and made multiple other public attacks on Lemon's intelligence over the years. Commentators noted that Trump's pattern of publicly attacking Black public figures' intelligence — Maxine Waters, LeBron James, Don Lemon, Al Sharpton, Barack Obama — followed a consistent racial targeting pattern. Lemon continued his journalism career and later wrote about the psychological impact of sustained attacks from a sitting president.
